overview: Metabolic syndrome is a cluster of conditions including increased waist circumference, high blood sugar, elevated blood pressure, abnormal cholesterol, and high triglycerides.

0_5.risk_interpretation: Your metabolic health is excellent with minimal evidence of metabolic syndrome risk.
diet_recommendations: Eat vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes, and lean proteins.
Choose healthy fats like nuts, seeds, and fish.
Limit processed foods, sugar, and excess salt.
monitoring_recommendations: Annual BP, glucose, and lipid screening.
0_5.positive_takeaway: Excellent metabolic health—maintain your current lifestyle.

diet_recommendations: Increase fibre intake.
Reduce refined carbohydrates and sugary foods.
monitoring_recommendations: Monitor BP, glucose, and waist periodically.
6_10.clinical_warning: Watch for gradual increases in blood pressure, glucose, or waist size.
6_10.positive_takeaway: Small lifestyle improvements now can preserve long-term metabolic health.

11_15.positive_takeaway: Early action can prevent progression toward metabolic syndrome.
